project.name: jinfer-xboundary
project.description: The x boundary cone (FloatTensor migration; see qxotic/.opencode/plans/memoryview-migration.md): the model-facing API every x model jar shares - Model/LanguageModel/EmbeddingModel/Reranker over jota MemoryView, Batch, the BaseState ownership/claiming machine (one PanamaMemoryArena behind an opaque MemoryArena accessor), Arenas.newCrossThread, LeakWatch. Extracted from jinfer-xlfm2 when the second model family (xqwen3) landed. Model jars depend on this + jinfer-xkernels, never on each other.
